primary_comparison: paired per-question original versus quantized output on the frozen 200-question final_test split

model.rule: unchanged across configurations; do not modify or re-download

vision_projector.rule: F16 vision source weights; unchanged artifact across configurations

generation.device: CPU only, no GPU layers, no mmproj offload, no warmup
generation.quantized_operators: vision transformer FFN up/down only; other operators and language path unchanged

scoring.implementation: MMF TextVQAAccuracyEvaluator and EvalAIAnswerProcessor vendored in experiments/rm13/vendor/m4c_evaluators.py
scoring.consensus_rule: leave-one-out TextVQA consensus, min(1, matching references / 3), after EvalAI normalization
scoring.failed_or_unparsed_answer: score as empty string and count as a hard failure
scoring.paired_delta: mean(quantized per-QID score - original per-QID score); percentage-point thresholds use absolute accuracy units

bootstrap.unit: question/image pair; resample paired per-QID deltas with replacement
bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile 95% interval, empirical 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles

primary_W4A8_both.interpretation: pass only if both the point-drop and lower-bound criteria pass; otherwise fail or remain inconclusive as reported

reference_W8A8_both.interpretation: pass only if both the point-drop and lower-bound criteria pass; otherwise fail or remain inconclusive as reported

quality_budget.scope_only_variants: diagnostic; report paired score and CI without independent promotion gates

hard_failures.criterion: no additional quantization-caused process failures or prediction-parse failures compared with the paired original outputs
hard_failures.local_operator_error_metrics: diagnostic only; maxabs, RMSE, cosine are not a quality pass/fail gate

output_review.representative_failure_review: inspect every new hard failure and every W4A8-both QID whose score drops by at least 0.3; categorize no-output/parser, repetition/noise, OCR/perception, or semantic error and preserve original/quantized text
unusual_output_flags: parser failure or non-zero process exit
three repeats of an identical token sequence of at least 3 tokens
generated token count reaches the 48-token cap
output_review.vision_embedding_or_logits: capture and compare final vision embeddings or logits if the pinned runtime exposes them; otherwise explicitly report unavailable and retain per-operator F32 output diagnostics

scope: This is a held-out TextVQA validation screen on the frozen sample, not evidence of an exact population accuracy loss or official test-set result.
